verdict.rationale: BigCommerce documents a broad developer toolkit — REST/GraphQL APIs, Checkout SDK, API Clients, Catalyst (Next.js) and Stencil (Handlebars) scaffolding, sandbox/trial stores, OAuth API accounts, and a single-click app marketplace for distribution — giving solid first-party coverage of SDKs, scaffolding, and a distribution channel. However, there's no detailed documented app review/certification workflow, and hands-on community reports describe the Stencil theming system as inconsistent and hard to work with and cite unreliable API connections/throttling, undercutting the polish of the developer experience. Missing for 10: an explicit documented app-review/certification process, a dedicated CLI scaffolding tool, and independent corroboration that the SDK/tooling experience is smooth in practice.
